source.description:
## Overview

Promote the fzf tmux session/pane picker from read-only switcher to an actionable, truthful, create-able control surface — with first-class awareness of specialist (`sp-*`) runs and rich worktree/bead context in previews.

## Goals

- **Truthful state**: agent and specialist states come from written hooks/options, not capture-pane guessing.
- **Act, don't just attach**: approve/interrupt/send-to panes directly from the list.
- **Create flow**: spawn worktree/new sessions from inside the picker.
- **Specialist-aware**: `sp-*` sessions are peers of agents in attention ranking, with job/bead/role enrichment and stale/orphan detection.
- **Safe + observable**: confirm before destructive kills, staleness badges, frecency, cache invalidation.

## Non-goals

- No TUI rewrite (bubbletea/gum). Stay bash + fzf.
- No daemon. No replacing tmux-resurrect.
- No mouse-support work.

## Success criteria

- [ ] `@agent_state` populated by pi/claude/codex hooks; WAIT/RUN/DONE badges reflect real transitions.
- [ ] Act-on-preview: one keystroke to approve / interrupt / send a line to any pane.
- [ ] Create flow: `prefix` + key → fzf over worktrees + recent dirs → new session.
- [ ] `sp-*` sessions show job/bead/role/state; feed attention ranking; stale/orphan panes flagged.
- [ ] All Tier 1/2/3 polish shipped; `test/contract.sh` green.

## Context

- Repo: https://github.com/Jaggerxtrm/xtmux (branch `main`).
- Perf baseline + architecture captured in `docs/perf-audit.md`.
- Status-line script (`scripts/git-pane-status.sh`) output contract must stay byte-identical (also used by the tmux status bar).
- Specialist data verified: session name `sp-<role>-<jobhash>`, cmd `bun`; jobs at `~/dev/specialists/.specialists/jobs/<hash>/`; `sp ps` reports running/waiting/orphans.
source.notes:
--- Audit 2026-06-30 (pre-implementation review of operator's hook plan) ---

Verified against authoritative sources:
- Claude Code hook events+semantics: context7 /anthropics/claude-code (all 9 event names valid: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, Notification). Confirmed live via operator's plugins (~30k hook refs).
- pi (v0.80.1) npm docs: pi has NO settings.json-style hooks — uses TypeScript extensions via pi.on(event). Correct event mapping added to xtmux-rib.2.
- ⚠️ pi `needs-input` gap: no documented event for awaits-permission. Sub-investigation logged in xtmux-rib.2.

Findings that changed the board:
1. NEW xtmux-rib.17 (P0, cache-split): regression in the perf-audit cache — it freezes agent-derived sort/badges for the TTL. Blocks xtmux-rib.2. tmux 3.5a has no option-changed hook, so must fix structurally.
2. NEW xtmux-rib.18 (P1, attn-jump binds): operator's draft had wrong script path (tmux-picker.sh vs tmux-session-picker) + M-digit collision risk. Path-corrected + collision policy documented.
3. UPDATED xtmux-rib.2: pi section rewritten (extension-based, not settings.json); needs-input gap logged.

Verified-correct (no board change): deliver() send-keys gate (#4), wait-for rendezvous semantics (#5), attn-jump target freshness (bypasses cache).
source.title: xtmux picker v0.2: actionable control surface + specialist awareness
